reviews.text:
I've been a patient here since I lived in Osaka.

The reason I continue to come here even after moving to Kobe is because it's affordable and the veterinarians are kind and attentive.

I come here every year not just for vaccinations, and not only are the fees low, but they even do free blood tests for my senior dog.

Thank you so much for everything.

My dog ​​passed away recently, the first time I'd ever experienced such a loss. Despite his difficult illness, the doctor provided incredibly compassionate care at every visit, and I am deeply grateful. I believe my dog ​​was happy because the doctor did everything possible until the very end.

He truly embodied the principle that "medicine is a benevolent art." The staff were also kind and gentle, making it a hospital where you can feel completely at ease.

Thank you so much.
I believe this is a compassionate hospital that puts the well-being of dogs and cats first and provides care while being attentive to the feelings of their owners.

The vet was very sincere, kind, and clearly had a deep love for animals.

I'm grateful for their thorough explanations and attentive support.

My beloved dog, who is also like family, seems to adore the vet, and I'm a little jealous!

Please continue to take good care of my beloved dog in the future.

The doctor is kind and a nice person. The nurses and reception staff were also very polite. When you make a reservation online, you can see how many people are ahead of you, and when it's three people ahead of you, you get a message saying "Please come in," so you don't have to wait too long at the hospital to be seen.

I think this is a very good animal hospital. As clearly stated on their website, they strive to keep costs down as much as possible when charging fees. This alone shows their commitment to providing honest treatment. I think the reason they attract so many patients is because everyone trusts them for their honest approach.

My cat is always well cared for here. Above all, they put my cat's well-being first, their service is polite, and their explanations are easy to understand. If anything happens, I always bring my cat here.

Thank you for your continued support.

We've been taking care of our two Maltipoo puppies since they were babies. The doctor is always so sincere in his treatment, and we trust him completely. We're so grateful to the doctor and staff for allowing us to raise our first pets with such peace of mind. Our two puppies are always overjoyed to see the doctor and nurses, wagging their tails excitedly.

We moved and tried going to a closer hospital, thinking it was unavoidable, but we've rediscovered the doctor's excellence and continue to drive all the way here.

Even if we end up living farther away in the future, we hope to continue receiving care from you. Thank you so much for always providing such thorough treatment despite your busy schedule. We look forward to continuing to rely on you.

My regular doctor was closed and the reviews were good, so I went in for my first consultation right before their opening hours. They performed a thorough examination and were very considerate. I had intended to go as a second doctor, but now I go every time, even though it's far away. When I complained about my dog's frequent licking of his paws recently, they suggested I try a different shampoo and even gave me two samples of different shampoos. The receptionist and assistant staff were all very kind, and my dog, who usually hates hospitals, was able to stay well. It was a great experience. The prices are reasonable and the place is always popular.

I thought this was a great hospital for first-time cat owners. The doctors and nurses were all very polite. The detailed explanations of the blood tests and abdominal ultrasound were very easy to understand, and I think the medication was administered appropriately. They were easy to talk to about any concerns I had, and I'll definitely make them my regular vet. As this was my first time going to the vet, I was prepared for the fees to be high (around 20,000-30,000 yen), but it was about half that price. I haven't compared it to other vets, but I thought it was financially easy for us to go there.
Also, it was great that you can make an online reservation and check the number of people waiting before bringing my cat to the hospital. I was worried the day before my visit, so I sent an inquiry with various questions, and they called me back as soon as they opened the next day.
I think this is a hospital that is very kind to both people and cats.
The director is very stylish!!

[Afro Animal Hospital]

Afro Animal Hospital, a veterinary hospital specializing in dogs and cats located in Tamatsukuri, Chuo Ward, Osaka City, is highly acclaimed for its attentive medical care and easy-to-understand explanations.
Many pet owners feel particularly reassured by its "efficient service" and "attentive listening attitude," resulting in many positive reviews.
Online reservations are also convenient for shortening wait times.
The exterior is colorful and impressive. With a wide range of preventive care and health checkup plans, this is a reliable veterinary hospital recommended for first visits and daily care.

[Afro Animal Hospital]

1-6-11 Kamimachi, Chuo Ward, Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture 540-0005

The fees are reasonable and the doctor is friendly and trustworthy, but when I went in after being called by the receptionist,
the details on the bill seemed different, so I asked about it, and another plump receptionist came out and said, "We're seeing patients right now, so it's not ready yet," as if it was my fault. I thought, "What about me?", but I went because I was called in.
In the end, they got my name on the bill wrong, and even though it was my fault, the person who called me by mistake didn't apologize, so I was left feeling frustrated.

I've been taking my pet to this vet since my previous dog. Today, the vet said he would take my pet's temperature first, which surprised me. I looked at some older reviews and understood why. Personally, I don't think taking a dog or cat's temperature is essential. I wonder if the person who wrote the review knew what a cat's normal body temperature is. For both dogs and cats, 39.5°C is considered normal, so anything significantly higher than that would be obvious. However, I think the vet took the reviews seriously, as he took my pet's temperature first. It's true that there's a long wait, but no matter how busy it is, the vet never tries to rush things. I think the wait is long because they give thorough examinations. I've never noticed any shedding of hair or any unpleasant smells, and the place is very clean. Even when it's busy, I've seen the reception staff carefully wiping the dirty floor several times. The long-serving receptionists aren't just friendly or unfriendly; they're incredibly competent, never make mistakes, and give accurate answers to any questions. Everyone has tough days, so those who wrote negative reviews might have just had a bad day, or perhaps the pet owner's attitude was also bad. If you go there regularly, you'll see that they are kind and gentle. The doctor seems destined to be a veterinarian; their diagnoses and treatments are extremely meticulous and careful. There's no way they'd do anything haphazardly. The low prices aren't for profit; they're a testament to the trust they provide proper treatment. Please refrain from coming solely for the low prices, as it only makes the clinic more crowded. For our family, it's a trustworthy hospital, and we're always grateful.

• The receptionist has apparently left. It's a shame, but the new person is also polite and kind.

Dr. Afro and all the nurses are kind and considerate in their examinations. I've seen some reviews about the attitude of the receptionists here, but I've never seen anything as concise and easy to understand as the explanations given by the receptionists here. I imagine that popular animal hospitals are busy and don't have time for casual conversation. What else could you ask for when they provide thorough explanations of medications and precautions? I'm always grateful to the receptionists. Thank you.

I transferred my cat from a hospital in a remote area of ​​Osaka (I had been going to about three hospitals locally). I was very impressed with the detailed explanation I received. Although my cat has various illnesses, I feel relieved that I can continue to live in this area with my beloved cat until the end of his life. Although the doctor is not able to perform surgery due to his health condition, I am grateful that he was able to introduce me to a reliable hospital.

I don't know why it has such high ratings, and why my experience was so unfavorable, but I think it's impossible. I brought a newly rescued kitten, less than three months old. Perhaps because they had a day off the day before, I arrived right after opening at 10:00 AM. There were already 11 other groups waiting, so I wasn't called until three hours later, around 1:00 PM. I didn't mind waiting at all. I thought that was a sign of their thorough examination. However, once I entered the examination room, they only administered flea medication and a blood test, without even taking my temperature. It would have been understandable if they'd been able to tell the kitten was healthy without taking a temperature, but in the middle of the night, my condition suddenly worsened. My kitten started breathing through its mouth, rolling its eyes, and exhibiting symptoms resembling epileptic seizures. All blood tests and other examination results were negative, and I was told there was no particular illness. As a kitten, I understand that it's normal for it to get sick quickly, but if they had at least taken my kitten's temperature or carefully monitored him, I might have noticed any signs of heatstroke or other illnesses, and the situation might have been different. I've been to many veterinary clinics, but I've never been to one that didn't take my temperature. I really can't trust them. It was really busy, so I don't know if they wanted to finish quickly, but the vet didn't even touch the kitten. I don't understand how he was a kind, good vet. Maybe he was the wrong doctor?
And in the end, it was four hours after I arrived at the hospital before I left.
If the vets were skilled, I wouldn't mind waiting four hours, but with this kind of sloppy work, four hours is just not possible.
I don't understand why the reviews are so good.
I wanted a proper examination.
Also, there was a lot of dog hair and it smelled bad.

I had distrust for the place I had been going to, so a friend recommended this clinic. The director is polite, makes quick decisions, and explains everything after the tests.
(As I'm an amateur, there are times when I don't understand.)
The nurses and receptionists are all kind, and if I have a question about receiving my medication, the receptionist will explain it clearly.
Online reservations are available for certain times. For other times, reservations must be made directly. You can see how many people are waiting online, so I don't waste time. Cash only is accepted for orders under 10,000 yen.
I'll continue to rely on this clinic.

As others have written, the doctor is very kind and explains things thoroughly, and the nurses are also very gentle. It has a good reputation, and initially, I came here based on word-of-mouth rather than reviews here.

However, the receptionist is always unfriendly and expressionless, and this reception, billing, and phone service are the only things that stress me out.

But since it's a hospital, the doctor is the most important thing, and I continue to go there. The staff don't seem to quit very often, so I think it's probably a good hospital environment.

Since all the patients come to the hospital with dogs and cats that have some kind of illness or injury, I feel that it would be better if the staff were more warm and attentive. They are so impersonal in their responses, but if that's the case, they could just use a robot to input names and symptoms for registration, and have the billing and payment processed automatically using a machine.

They provide excellent care, and the doctor, staff, and groomers are all very kind.

There are reviews mentioning the receptionist, but she quickly remembers the names of both the owner and the dog, works efficiently, and always provides a very pleasant service. I am grateful!

This is a trustworthy local animal hospital that I want to continue taking my pet to for a long time.

He always explains things carefully and is a trustworthy doctor who is very kind to dogs.
And what's more, his prices are always surprisingly low!
I wish he would raise his prices even more.
